title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection- File Labeler and File Viewer for MacOS
description: This feature is bringing the Information Protection Filer Labeler and Viewer applications to the MacOS platform. Enabling customers to have the same capabilities available on Mac. Core functionality will be available with the exception of the Advanced label-based protection feature.
